allText: contact about sign our waiver adult classes kid classes competitions birthday parties personal training summer camps springfield warrior sports community springfield warrior sports was founded with a love for and desire to serve our community community unites us and allows us to be a part of something greater than ourselves it provides an opportunity to connect with people and other local businesses who when we all work together make this the awesome community so many of us call home we strive to provide a safe place and outlet for youth and adults who are looking for a fun and different workout and the freedom to move as they set and achieve their goals on their quest for a healthy lifestyle we also love going out into the community to serve outside of our walls through adopt a highway partnering with local events and speaking at school assemblies we are most certainly stronger together curious about the colors of our gym our inspiration is the new springfield flag which has nods to our culture and history well let you look that up but the main goal of the developers was to come up with an authentic icon that people connected with and could use to express their pride living in springfield john mcqueary community adopt a highway clean up days springfield warrior sports is proud to help keep a little piece of our community cleaner we have adopted the highway on south campbell between weaver and plainview near the gym we love doing our part and think its awesome that the warrior sports crew members and friends can come together and be involved its also a good time thanks to thrivent financial for sponsoring the event and to mid missouri bank for allowing us to meet in your community room we are truly stronger together community partnerships big brothers big sisters of the ozarks a mentor empowers a person to see a possible future and believe it can be obtained big brothers big sisters of the ozarks makes impactful monitored matches between adult volunteers bigs and children littles ages 6 through 14 through this program positive relationships are developed that have a direct and lasting effect on the lives of young people in our community at springfield warrior sports we applaud and want to support their mission bigs when you drop in for open gym your little gets in free come have fun or maybe challenge each other to something new together we are stronger one obstacle at at time supplement superstore we want to give a huge shout out to supplement superstore s2 has been a huge supporter of springfield warrior sports and our athletes over the years and these guys are doing it right they have solid fitness nutrition products and considerately share expert advice after listening to your specific goals they can offer personal training nutrition coaching and meal plans and they wont leave you hanging you can expect that they will check in on your progress as they truly want you to succeed go check them out now all ages and athletic backgrounds perseverance persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success the very nature of this sport involves setting goals for yourself hard work and determination perseverance and supportive friends community at springfield warrior sports we love the opportunity to share our experiences failures and successes through the sport and training on and off the course with the youngest of athletes and individuals we are available to speak demonstrate and provide interactive team building for your next school assembly field day or youth activity each of us are stronger one obstacle at a time in 2016 we had the unique opportunity to work with james river church planning their ninja warrior course that was a part of their stronger mens conference under jason huewes direction springfield warrior sports assisted with design and build of the course running the west campus competition and securing athletes from across the country we also held a local competition at the gym where the top 5 athletes secured their spot to compete on the course alongside the american ninja warriors who attended for their chance to win $5000 what a night so much fun being a part of this collaboration and display of camaraderie with such inspiring individuals each modeling that we are stronger one obstacle at a time community murph springfield warrior sports looks forward each year to bringing a team and participating in the local annual community murph every year on memorial day the southwest missouri community comes together to honor our fallen heroes funds are raised for local charities so that they can continue to provide support for these families we are so encouraged to be a part of this event and have watched it continue to grow with this communities engagement nationwide this event has raised millions of dollars for charities including the lt michael p murphy memorial scholarship foundation seal its a grueling challenge that brings people together to pay tribute and the tradition helps push us humble us both mentally and physically and dedicate a bit of pain and sweat to honor a man who gave everything he had we are stronger together client testimonials what our clients say we had our sons 10th birthday here all of the kids had a great time they set up an obstacle course for the kids they loved the whole experience the favorite was the curved wall to run up that was everyones challenge for the night we will be visiting again for sure jennifer l my daughter started training here 3 years ago at 8 and she still loves it owner and coaching staff are all super encouraging we live an hour away but make the drive twice a week as often as possible training here has not only helped her get stronger physically but increased her confidence in general anything that makes kids want to challenge themselves to get better and better is worth it lee c our accomplished and award winning crew are here to help you find your strength and enjoy your workouts contact 605 w farm rd 182 springfield mo 65810 united states 417 894 7319 office swarriorsports com quick links home about us contact us
